scripts.docker:local:build: docker build -f apps/portal/Dockerfile -t family-portal-portal:local . && docker build -f apps/portal/Dockerfile.migrate -t family-portal-portal-migrate:local . && docker build -f apps/calendar/Dockerfile.monorepo -t family-portal-calendar:local . && docker build -f apps/calendar/Dockerfile.migrate -t family-portal-calendar-migrate:local .
scripts.docker:local:up: npm run docker:local:build && docker compose -f docker-compose.local.yml up
scripts.podman:local:build: podman build -f apps/portal/Dockerfile -t family-portal-portal:local . && podman build -f apps/portal/Dockerfile.migrate -t family-portal-portal-migrate:local . && podman build --build-arg NEXT_PUBLIC_PORTAL_AUTH_URL=http://localhost:3100 -f apps/calendar/Dockerfile.monorepo -t family-portal-calendar:local . && podman build -f apps/calendar/Dockerfile.migrate -t family-portal-calendar-migrate:local .
scripts.podman:local:up: npm run podman:local:build && podman-compose -f docker-compose.local.yml up
